- **Available MCP Tools (16+):**
  - `get_profile`: Core identity, headline, and summary
  - `get_bio`: Extended narrative background
  - `get_experience`: Work history with roles and impact
  - `get_projects`: Full project portfolio
  - `get_project_detail`: Deep-dive on a single project
  - `get_project_deep_dive`: Architecture-level project breakdown
  - `get_skills`: Skills grouped by category and depth
  - `get_tech_stack`: Languages, frameworks, and tools used
  - `get_system_design`: System design decisions and trade-offs
  - `get_interview_qa`: Pre-answered technical interview questions
  - `get_current_focus`: Active learning & project goals
  - `get_work_preferences`: Role, team, and work-style fit
  - `get_contact`: Official contact channels
  - `get_availability_status`: Open-to-work / freelance status
  - `check_slots`: Open meeting slots on calendar
  - `book_appointment`: Schedules a call directly via chat

# 3. Professional Summary & Philosophy
Vasudev Darse Shikari is a Full Stack Engineer based in Hyderabad with 2+ years of production experience across FinTech, EdTech, and SaaS. He specializes in:
1. **Java Full Stack Development:** Enterprise microservices, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, PostgreSQL, MySQL.
2. **MERN Stack Development:** MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js.
3. **AI & Agentic Frameworks:** Building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool-calling schemas, Claude & OpenAI API integrations, and RAG pipelines.
4. **Full-Stack Engineering:** Building complete initial software platforms for early-stage startups, taking ideas from concept to production-ready architecture.
5. **Freelance Engineering:** Available for full-stack contract work, technical advisory, and custom AI integrations.

# 4. Key Projects Portfolio (Ordered)
1. **ElevateHub (Astravora):** AI-native learning, exam and career platform live in production — proctored exams, coding challenges in 8 languages (Piston sandbox), a six-agent GitHub project reviewer, AI mock interviewer, skill gap analyzer, Socratic tutor, RAG over study material, collaborative notes (Yjs), an MCP server with 60+ tools for instructors, and a React Native app. 7 apps, about 10 services, PostgreSQL with 112 models. Live: https://astravora.in | Repository: https://github.com/Tech-by-Vasu/Edu-Tech-Platform
2. **CORE (Cross Operational Resource Engine):** Enterprise workforce and project platform — HR, agile project management, client portal and invoicing, real-time messaging — with a LangGraph agent layer (15 graphs, human-in-the-loop sprint manager, AgentFlow visual workflow builder, RAG) and an OAuth 2.1 MCP server exposing about 145 role-gated tools. Java/Spring Boot core, TypeScript AI service, React 19, Docker. Live: https://core.dsvasudev.in | Repository: https://github.com/dsvasudev19/CORE
3. **Agentic AI Portfolio (MCP Connector):** A live AI agent that answers questions about Vasudev, built on a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 16 tools (profile, projects, skills, system design, calendar booking) that Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can also use. LangChain + LangGraph agent, streaming answers, model fallbacks.
4. **DigiSchool Apps:** School management ERP on Spring Cloud microservices — admissions, attendance, exams, fees, payroll, library and transport — with a student and parent mobile app (React Native), Temporal workflows, WebAuthn and MFA security, and an AI study assistant behind a server-side child-safety pipeline.
5. **Co-Investing Platform (Kupa Inc):** Co-investment workflows and real-time portfolio tracking for high-net-worth investors across multiple asset classes.
6. **ProjeXpert:** Enterprise project management platform built with Node.js, Express, React, MySQL, and GitHub API integration.
7. **SmartTransit System:** Microservices-based public transportation system built with Java Spring Boot, Netflix Eureka, Ola Maps API, and Docker.
8. **Vehicle Rentals System:** Vehicle rental marketplace platform built with Spring Boot, Angular, and React.
9. **Chatterbox:** Real-time chat application built with Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and React.
10. **Banking Website:** Secure banking web portal with robust multi-layered architecture.
11. **roughAge E-Commerce:** Produce delivery platform built on React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
